name: Benzgalantamine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: A prodrug converted to active galantamine. Galantamine subsequently undergoes CYP2D6/CYP3A4 metabolism and glucuronidation; clearance also includes unchanged galantamine in urine.
